sources.author: kimjooyoon
sources.scope: Owned planning interpretation and adjustable presentation defaults; not an upstream repository rule.

criteria.rule: Record the issue/proposal/solicited-PR intake request as this participant feedback; do not label it a discovered CONTRIBUTING rule.
Keep external-review role and moderation uncertainty distinct; decline duplicate unrequested confirmation.
Lead with the bounded outcome, one minimal example and at most one needed action. Word length is advisory, never a correctness or acceptance score.

presentation.focus: External-review role, intake scope and whether new information is useful.
avoid: Speculating about moderation motive or account blocking.
Calling a review COMMENTED state a dismissal.

limits: A bounded source snapshot is not a complete policy inventory or current posting authority.
Actor association is recorded verbatim; a collaborator or contributor is not automatically a maintainer.
No personality, acceptance probability or universal AI policy is inferred.
